404.title: Page not found
body: If you typed the web address, check it is correct.
If you pasted the web address, check you copied the entire address.

500.title: Sorry, there is a problem with the service
body: We have not saved your answers.
Use our means assessment resources for guidance on checking a client's eligibility.
Contact our customer services team for support with legal aid administration or training:

declaration.title: Declaration
declaration.text:
By continuing, you agree that:
  • your client has instructed you, the provider, to act on their behalf
  • your client has read the LAA privacy policy (opens in a new window or tab)
  • you'll give complete and correct information

validation.required: Please select an option to continue

options.notPossibleBeforeStart: It's not possible to get it before starting the work

evidenceOfIncome.title: Do you have evidence of your client's income?
evidenceOfIncome.hint: You can use the same piece of evidence across different categories. Select all that apply.

evidenceTypes.letterFromFriendOrFamily: Letter from friend or family providing support
evidenceTypes.latestBenefitChangeLetter: Latest letter showing change in benefit amount

validation.required: You must select an income evidence to continue

evidenceOfExpenditure.title: Evidence of your client's expenditure
evidenceOfExpenditure.linkText: Check the risk-based evidence guidelines (opens in a new window or tab).
evidenceOfExpenditure.description: You only need to gather evidence of your client's expenditure if they are close to the threshold and there is a risk of them being ineligible.

groupsOfEvidence.childCare: Child Care costs in excess of £600 per month

validation.required: You must select a capital evidence to continue

sign.title: Sign the declaration
statement: Download a copy of the details you entered for your client and get them to sign the declaration.
You must save a copy along with any evidence provided by your client. Your client’s file may be audited and assessed by the LAA at a later date.
sign.confirmLabel: I confirm that I have a signed declaration from my client
sign.dateHint: This is your case start date and the date you can bill from

error.dateInvalid: Date of signature must be a real date

error.dateMissingYear: Date of signature must include a year

confirm.title: Confirm the following
declarationList: they've instructed me, the provider, to act on their behalf
they've read the LAA privacy policy (opens in a new window or tab)
the information they've given is complete and correct
they'll report any changes to their financial situation immediately
confirm.warningText: If they give wrong or incomplete information, do not report changes or are found to have committed benefit fraud, they may:
warningList: need to pay a financial penalty
have their legal aid stopped and have to pay back the costs

eligibilityResult.title: Eligibility result
eligibilityResult.eligible: Your client qualifies financially for civil legal aid based on the information you entered.

nextList: The LAA will store the details you've provided. You must save a copy for your own records which you should keep along with any evidence provided by your client.
Your client's file may be audited and assessed by the LAA at a later date.
